## What happened / 发生了什么

## Expected behavior / 期望结果

## Reproduce / 复现步骤

Include the toolbox commit, tool ID, upstream adopted commit, and the command you ran.

## Output / 输出

Paste a short error excerpt with credentials, personal paths, and private content removed. Security vulnerabilities belong in the private reporting flow described in SECURITY.md.
